originality.rationale: Inspected exact census algorithm enumerating EVERY nonempty connected step set for 3<=n<=14 by gcd(n,steps)=1 and recursively all independent faces, computing integral Smith normal forms (not mod-p surrogates) of all positive boundary maps. Independently RECOMPUTED all 338 connected cases and exactly six n=14 torsion-positive S, each with a unique factor 2 in H1. Disconnected circulants are joins of d gcd-components of order n/d<=7 when d>1,n<=14; all constituent integral homology groups are torsion-free in the census, so join Kunneth remains torsion-free. Independently checked 14 actual free-face collapse pairs in the nonpure case, the final 14/42/28 closed nonorientable surface with cyclic vertex links and Euler characteristic 0, and the pure representative via exact Q7,2 triangle-list map i->3i mod14. Different valences 6 vs7 separate the two unit orbits. Finite n<=14 census is EXHAUSTIVE over the theorem finite domain, not extrapolated to all n.
residual_risks: Complete classification deliberately stops at n=14; there is no all-orders absence or classification.
Hidden older database entries for n13 and the nonpure n14 orbit cannot be ruled out absolutely from bounded literature search.

value.rationale: The first-order exact torsion threshold for ALL circulants n<=14, especially the nonpure six-regular exceptional orbit and explicit Klein-bottle collapse, closes a natural finite classification not settled by Q7,2 manifold tables.
